ticket.summary: Content Widget merger changes for Launchers.
ticket.description: As part of The Unified Content Experience, launchers are also becoming part of the Content Tab and will now be visible under "Content" on the studio as well aqs the Dashboard. The Launcher configurations like create, edit, delete, copy etc. will also behave respectively. This change affects the DAP for Web product line.

change_note.summary: As part of the Unified Content Experience, Launchers are merged into the Content tab and are now visible under "Content" in the Studio as well as the Dashboard. Launcher actions such as create, edit, delete and copy behave accordingly in the new experience.
change_note.old: Launchers were not listed under the Content tab in the Studio or the Dashboard.
change_note.new: Launchers are listed under "Content" in the Studio and the Dashboard, and launcher configurations (create, edit, delete, copy, etc.) work from there.
change_note.notes: The "old" state is inferred from the ticket wording ("also becoming part of the Content Tab"); the ticket doesn't describe where Launchers lived before. No effective date was stated. The description says create, edit, delete, copy "etc." behave "respectively" without specifics, so the exact behavior changes need confirmation. No attachments were provided.
